idea.h: Diversify logistics networks to mitigate risks from the Black Sea becoming the world's deadliest shipping lane.
idea.why: Secure alternative routes and increase inventory buffers for goods transiting through high-risk zones like the Black Sea and Hormuz. Recent reports of intensified conflict in the Black Sea and Maersk's data breach highlight escalating geopolitical supply chain vulnerabilities that threaten freight reliability.
